title: Directional Linear Separability of Neural Representations: Geometry and Transformations
abstract: arXiv:2606.08721v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Neural networks build representations through affine maps and nonlinear activations. Injective affine maps preserve linear separability, raising the problem of how they prepare data for nonlinear improvement and how much gain can be guaranteed before complete separation. We introduce the directional linear separability measure (D-LSM), which quantifies unavoidable competing-sample intrusion over affine halfspaces retaining every target sample, characterize its supporting geometry, and prove invariance under injective affine embeddings. For gated activations including ReLU, GELU, and SiLU, pre-activation projection bounds yield sufficient conditions for preserving all previous exclusions and recovering additional samples, with a gain bound determined by the certified recovery count. Under an aggregate-tube condition, an explicit affine construction realizes recovery with sufficient width, scaling conditions, and simultaneous multiclas

translated_title: 神经表示的方向性线性可分性：几何与变换
translated_abstract: 神经网络通过仿射映射与非线性激活来构建表示。单射仿射映射能够保持线性可分性，由此引出一个问题：它们如何为非线性改进准备数据，以及在完全分离之前能够保证多少增益。我们引入了方向性线性可分性度量，它量化了在保留所有目标样本的仿射半空间上不可避免的竞争样本侵入，刻画了其支撑几何结构，并证明了该度量在单射仿射嵌入下的不变性。对于包括ReLU、GELU和SiLU在内的门控激活函数，预激活投影界给出了保持所有先前排除关系并恢复额外样本的充分条件，其增益界由经认证的恢复样本数确定。在聚合管条件下，一个显式的仿射构造以足够的宽度、缩放条件以及同时的多类分离实现了样本恢复。
tldr: 本文提出方向性线性可分性度量（D-LSM），证明了其在单射仿射嵌入下的不变性，并为ReLU等门控激活函数给出了在完全分离之前可保证恢复多少样本的充分条件与增益界。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the directional linear separability measure (D-LSM), proves its invariance under injective affine embeddings, and establishes sufficient conditions and gain bounds for how many samples gated activations like ReLU can guarantee to recover before complete separation.
